comment: Honestly, i am shocked at the comments on here, I love Professor Mack-Shelton she is amazing! very funny, sarcastic and has a very analytical teaching approach. It's challenging, YES! but this is college if you want easy A's go back to elementary. If you want to learn and become a true scholar = Take Mack-Shelton

I am glad I did not read the comments on this site prior to taking Dr. Mack Shelton's AFST 353 class at UMBC.  I might have missed an absolutely amazing professor.  She has an incredibly energetic & insightful teaching style. Pay attention in class.  She gives all of the test answers in her lectures - you just have to study and LISTEN - no tricks.

She offers lots of opportunities for extra credit and if you communicate a personal issue with something she will work with you . She is easily my favorite professor since I started college, and I have been in school for 3 years!!!

This teacher was amazing. She inspired me to minor in Africana Studies becasue of the way she spoke. Anyone who thinks she is biased wasn't paying attention in class. She is very playful which is great becasue she helps break the ice.She values good writing and the ability to be a critical thinker

I am an older student and a senior and I found her very helpful. She was funny and engaging and encouraged class participation. The book was bad but if you watched the films and took good notes you would do well. She gave out notes twice, and extra credit opportunities. Because of her encouragement I changed my major and am going to law school.

She is one of the best professors i ever had. She is punctual,funny and very fair. She does not give you grades you do not earn. She is very understanding and helps students a lot went it comes to difficult times. Stop jurging her n get to know her.
Very lively teacher, makes lectures interesting. Gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. overall a really good teacher :)

One of the best professors that I have ever had the pleasure of learning from. Her class is fun, she keeps you interested and awake with her energy, and she has a wealth of knowledge about African American history. She's one of the few professors from whom you'll learn a little more about life. Shes a professor that you remember after college.

Very enthusiastic professor who cares about her students and subject matter. Exam questions come straight from book and lecture, and much extra credit given. Make sure margins are correct on paper! Take for easy A
she is very funny

She's pretty funny but is way too picky when it comes to formatting papers. The margin is always too high or too low! However, she gives lots of extra credit opportunities which is nice. I would recommend taking this class if you need an easy class to fill your arts and humanities credits.

Professor Mack-Shelton was a wonderful professor and she shows a lot of enthusiasm for the subject she is teaching. If you follow her syllabus and do the assigned readings, then you will not have a problem getting a good grade in her class.

She is a great professor that cares for students. I had some registration issues and she helped me out a lot. She grades fairly. The exams could be tricky if you don't do the assigned readings on time. She is very funny and tells many stories from her life that relate to the course material. Good luck! :)
Professor Mack-Shelton was amazing! I had many problems come up during the semester I took her class and she took time to help me succeed in her class and my other classes.

She was one of the best professors I had, she answers all your questions if you ask. She was so helpful and class was really interesting. The tests were kind of hard, and basically completely off the textbook readings.

In my opinion, this teacher happen to be one of the most creative teachers at UMBC. She requires attentiveness and responsibility. If you are paying attention to her lectures (writing notes, and notes for videos) you should do fine in the class. For warning her exams are hard if you aren't careful but she gives extra credit assignments.

She is a BRILLIANT & knows her history;very intellectual; makes us think outside the box. Makes us work hard. We LOVED this class & Dr Shelton.These nasty comments are from a mean group of angry losers who did poorly in class & its obvious. Ignore their comments PLEASE!! They are LIES!  This site is to aid students and not hurt teachers.Grow Up!

Well I had Dr. Mack Shelton at UMBC and I love her passion and enthusiasm about African studies. She is very funny and I enjoyed coming to her class once a week. I dont like the way her exams are structured because nothing that she lectured on in class was on the exams, it was based on all textbooks readings that we never went over in class.

Took AfAm history 1 with her fall 2007 and she was great; very picky writing rules but didn't mind since it helped my writing; funny; knows her history; makes learning interesting. Challenges traditional thinking. Hate I didn't take a second class with her before her sabbatical leave. She is a "must take professor" before you graduate!!!!  .

Excellent professor! One of the BEST Ive ever had (and Im a senior!) She made the class interesting, fun, and made sure everyone understood. She is very pretty and has a great sense of humor. I would love to take her again! I wish more professors were like Dr. MackShelton!
Fair, honest, makes you think, challenging, and very intellectual and analytical in her lectures!  and very pretty!!!
She makes you want to come to class every day: smart,  super knowledge in her field, funny, caring, and a true teacher who loves to teach!
Great sense of humor and brilliant!!
good person. entertaining to watch. fair grader. good sense of humor. if you put in work and follow her picky writing rules you will end up with a A or B.
Not a true teacher of history, more of a talker on topics.  A nice person, but not much of a scholar.  Puts little effort in for planning interesting material.  A topical approach to history.
great class, very interesting and engaging. Mack-Shelton is a great prof and great person.
Terrible historian--she just tells you the facts. Great for those who doesn't have a brain. Quite a lot of assignments, but you can turn in the SAME paper several times a get an A+!
No Comments

Took both parts of her African American History class.  Made A+s both times. Not too much reading; 3 easy tests; easy term paper; lots of extra credit opportunities.  She's fun, entertaining, and energetic.  No complaints!

I took her Civil Rights class and it was great!  not too much reading, straightforward tests, and an easy term paper.  She makes the class fun and has lots of energy all the time.  Definitely enjoyed it and would take her again.
